_meta.note: The legacy shape with the flat per-model cap blocks populated (CCM-45, Android's CCBG-8). `seven_day_sonnet` is attested by OpenQuota reading it; `seven_day_opus` is null-present in our captured payloads, so its populated form follows the same block shape. Pins that model caps survive the `limits` array being absent — without the fallback they degrade to an empty list, indistinguishable from an account that has no caps, and nothing ever flags the loss. The null-opus counterpart (a flat cap key that must NOT materialise a cap) is pinned by legacy-blocks-only.json.
